podcast.title: Initial Fame with The Selecter (1979-1982)
podcast.body: Hendrickson was an integral part of The Selecter during their initial period of significant fame, which spanned from 1979 to 1982. "He was with the band during their initial rush of fame between 1979 and 1982."

podcast.title: Death Details - June 11, 2024
podcast.body: Arthur "Gaps" Hendrickson died at the age of 73 on June 11th, 2024. "He died at the age of 73 on June 11th, 2024."

podcast.title: Coventry Background and Jamaican Music
podcast.body: Arthur "Gaps" Hendrickson was one of many young people in Coventry, England, who discovered Jamaican music through the city's immigrant communities in the 1970s. "Arthur Gaps Hendrickson was one of the many bridge kids in and around Coventry England to discover Jamaican music through the many immigrants that had settled in the city."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Founding Member of The Selecter
podcast.body: He was a founding member of The Selecter, serving as one of the vocalists alongside frontwoman Pauline Black. "He found some like-minded individuals and was a founding member of the selector when he became one of the vocalists next to frontwoman Pauline Black."
